description:
Activate Throne of Empires by paying {1} and tapping it, creating five 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Soldier, untapping a basic Island you control.
Activate the Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Throne of Empires.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Soldiers and mana, you may activate either Scepter of Empires or Crown of Empires' abilities instead.
